output_list.criticism: The 'mint' function has an integer overflow that allows the ICO initial allocator to set the total supply to 150 * 1e6 * 1e18 tokens, arbitrarily. This vulnerability can be exploited to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens, potentially leading to a loss of funds for the ICO initial allocator.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow in 'super.transfer' due to 'require(!tokensAreFrozen)', restricting it to be exploitable in real world. This vulnerability can be exploited to transfer an arbitrary amount of tokens, potentially leading to a loss of funds for the sender.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow in 'super.transferFrom' due to 'require(!tokensAreFrozen)', restricting it to be exploitable in real world. This vulnerability can be exploited to transfer an arbitrary amount of tokens, potentially leading to a loss of funds for the sender.

The 'approve' function has an integer overflow in 'super.approve' due to 'require(!tokensAreFrozen)', restricting it to be exploitable in real world. This vulnerability can be exploited to approve an arbitrary amount of tokens, potentially leading to a loss of funds for the sender.
